note: A build-definition change judged by its effect (register decision 250). Each mutant takes away one part of the rule or of its fallbacks: the build definition ignored where no fingerprint can speak, a changed fingerprint ignored, a new judge ignored, a test's line number counted, the placeholders applied to nothing, untracked files left out of a program's fingerprint, and a pass that records no fingerprints. Judged by the self-tests of mutants-due.py and mutate.py, which hold each rule as a case. Not a mutant here: main_check's use of the comparison, which only a record from a real pass can exercise -- it was measured instead on the real tree on 2026-09-30 (a comment in CMakeLists.txt made no fingerprint change; a compile definition on orbsim_core made due every file whose judges link it). Since M1-109 (register decision 392) a Python mutant names no build target, and the harness builds nothing for it; until then every mutant named orbsim_shaders as a no-op, which made every shader an input of this file.

mutants.name: a record without fingerprints ignores a build-definition change
mutants.find: watched = ALWAYS + BUILD_DEFINITION if judged is None else ALWAYS

mutants.name: a changed fingerprint is ignored
mutants.find: reasons = hits + sorted(set(always) - set(hits)) + sorted(judged or [])

mutants.name: a judge that is new since the pass is ignored
mutants.replace:
if was.get(key) == now.get(key) or key not in was:
            continue

mutants.name: a test's line number counts
mutants.find: kept = {key: value for key, value in test.items() if key != "backtrace"}

mutants.name: untracked files are left out of a program's fingerprint
mutants.find: return "\n".join(f"{placeholders(path, tree, root)} {digest}" for path, digest in sorted(chosen))

mutants.name: a pass records no fingerprints
mutants.find:
if judges is not None:
        record["judges"] = judges
